note: Third-party plugins are NOT vendored in this repository. Install them from npm by exact name and version. Order matters only for the two that depend on dsh-claude-style.

plugins.name: dsh-claude-style
plugins.title: Claude Style 皮肤
plugins.note: Dependency of dsh-claude-style-addons and dsh-whale-splash. Install first.

plugins.name: dsh-better-sidebar
plugins.title: 侧栏增强
plugins.note: File tree / git / search in the right sidebar.

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen
plugins.title: 生图工作台
plugins.note: chatgpt-sub provider needs a fresh OAuth login on the new machine.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-subscriptions
plugins.title: 订阅账号中转
plugins.note: Needs a version exemption on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; see profile/compatibility.json.example.

plugins.name: dsh-status-rotator
plugins.title: 状态轮播
plugins.note: Its settings do not migrate; reconfigure on the new machine.

plugins.name: dsh-balance-widget
plugins.title: 余额 / 花费卡片
plugins.note: Patched by the local plugin dsh-balance-widget-patch (self-healing, no manual step). The patch fixes the Windows sessions root, fixes session anchoring on DSH 0.2.x, folds subagent cost into this-session totals, and adds a balance <-> OpenCode Go quota mode switch.

plugins.name: dshmarket
plugins.title: 插件市场
plugins.note: Can install the others by name; pin versions manually.

plugins.name: @modusensus/dsh-mneme
plugins.title: 跨会话记忆库
plugins.note: Optional local embedding runtime downloads models on first use. Memory data does not migrate.

patches.summary: Applied automatically by the dsh-balance-widget-patch plugin: resolve the sessions root on Windows (HOME is unset; DSH_HOME/USERPROFILE are used), fix session anchoring on DSH 0.2.x, fold subagent/team-member cost into this-session and today totals, and add the balance <-> OpenCode Go quota mode switch.
patches.apply: node plugins/dsh-balance-widget-patch/tools/profile.mjs add --profile desktop && dsh plugin --profile desktop install

legacy.note: Superseded by the plugin above; kept as history. Fails loudly if the newer payload is already applied.
